label: Route Scope
description: Writes explicit top-level route prefixes to config.json routes.on or routes.off.

properties.name: route_list
properties.label: Configuration list
properties.help: on enables the plugin for matching first URL segments. off excludes matching first URL segments.

properties.name: paths
properties.label: Route prefixes
properties.help: Comma-separated or one per line. /page and page both compile as page. Use one Route Scope node for routes.on and another for routes.off.
